findings.evidence: Place.lean:162-172 defines `hcomp` locally; it is consumed at lines 175, 179, 181. Its statement mentions neither `I` nor `hdeg`.
findings.fix: Extract a standalone lemma, e.g. `theorem ringHom_comp_mk_eq (ρ : W.CoordinateRing →+* F) (hρ : ∀ c, ρ (algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c) = c) : ρ.comp (CoordinateRing.mk W) = evalEvalRingHom (ρ (mk W (C X))) (ρ (mk W Y))` plus its corollary `W.Equation (ρ (mk W (C X))) (ρ (mk W Y))`, and let `exists_equation_and_eq_XYIdeal` apply them. The auxiliary `hCC` (line 166) is likewise the reusable `mk W (C (C c)) = algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c` (compare the private `mk_C_eq_algebraMap` at `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/Affine/CoordinateRing.lean:92`).
findings.issue: `hcomp` — every ring hom `F[W] →+* F` fixing the constants equals `evalEvalRingHom` at the images of the two coordinates, and the resulting pair satisfies `W.Equation` (`heq`, line 173) — is a general statement about the coordinate ring, independent of `I` and of the rank hypothesis, yet it is hidden inside `exists_equation_and_eq_XYIdeal` and used three times there (heq, the `XClass` goal, the `YClass` goal). The PR's own provenance note records that AINTLIB exposes these as separate declarations (`exists_coordinates_of_isMaximal_of_surjective`, `equation_of_coordinates_of_field`).

findings.evidence: `AlgEquiv.ofBijective : (A₁ →ₐ[R] A₂) → Bijective f → A₁ ≃ₐ[R] A₂` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Equiv.lean:558; `Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ` exists. Place.lean:152-158 shows the two rewrite chains, each opening with `rw [hρ, …]` to undo the `set` at lines 149-151.
findings.fix: Build `ρ : W.CoordinateRing →ₐ[F] F` as `(AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId F _) hbij).symm.toAlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ F I)`; then `hρalg` is `ρ.commutes` and `hρmem` reduces to `Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem` after one `simp`. Drop the `set … with` / `rw [he], rw [hρ]` round trip (use plain local definitions, or `simp only [ρ]`).
findings.issue: `ρ` is built as a bare `RingHom` via `RingEquiv.ofBijective`, so `hρalg` (the fact that `ρ` fixes constants) needs a five-step rewrite chain through `RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom`, `Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq` and `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply`; and both `set … with he` / `set … with hρ` are undone by `rw [he]` / `rw [hρ]` in the very next tactic blocks, so `set` abstracts nothing and only obscures the terms.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/FreeAndStrongRankCondition.lean:298-303: `lemma _root_.Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap [Module.Free F E] : … := by refine ⟨?_, …⟩; nontriviality E`; the section variables at line 239 are `[CommRing F] [StrongRankCondition F] [Ring E] [Algebra F E]`, with no `Nontrivial E`.
findings.fix: Delete the `have hnt` line (and the `hI` use it suggests) unless the build shows it is needed.
findings.issue: `hnt : Nontrivial (W.CoordinateRing ⧸ I)` appears to be a redundant hypothesis: the only lemma that could consume it, `Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap`, takes only `[Module.Free F E]` (supplied here by `Module.Free.of_divisionRing`) and performs `nontriviality E` internally; nothing else in the proof needs a `Nontrivial` instance.

summary: The proofs are short and mostly ext-lemma driven, but the classification proof buries a general reusable fact (a ring hom out of the coordinate ring is evaluation at the coordinate images) and builds `ρ` as a bare `RingHom`, forcing named-lemma rewrite chains that `AlgHom.commutes` would give for free; one `have` looks dead.
